purpose: Discovery implementation diagnostic, not alpha validation or a stable-effect claim

questions.market: 请帮我寻找 A 股未来 1—3 年值得考虑的投资机会，不预设行业或公司。请自行研究公开信息，说明哪些对象及条件更有吸引力，也可以得出目前没有合适机会的结论。研究截止日为 2026-09-21。
questions.grid: 电网投资与电力系统结构正在变化，A 股未来三年有哪些值得考虑的投资机会？请自行核实变化、受益关系和价格条件，不把产业相关公司名单直接当成投资机会。研究截止日为 2026-09-21。
questions.packaging: 如何寻找 A 股包装行业未来两年的投资机会？请研究具体对象、经济机制与价格，可以得出没有合适机会的结论，不要求新技术或转型故事。研究截止日为 2026-09-21。

runtime: Fresh fork_turns=none subagents, inherited root model/settings; exact backend version and token usage not exposed
tools: Same web retrieval and local calculation tools; no subagents inside runs, no personal history or accounts; quantitative signal tool excluded in this comparison
resource_note: Experiment-only equal ceilings; not daily skill restrictions. Read calls to frozen methods and artifact writes are not calculations.
decision_rule: Two independent blinded reviewers must both identify verified substantive gain without major factual or coverage errors; disagreement is no clear advantage, not averaged away.
limitations: Single run per condition/question; no statistical reliability
Executor-authored tool logs, not independent network capture
Single-agent host condition; parallel orchestration untested
Installed skill metadata may remain visible to plain runs, but reading/using skill content is prohibited

excluded_attempts.reason: Executor accidentally read combined methods snapshot; stopped before research. Restarted with isolated condition directory.

method_storage: Exact per-path contents retained in methods.json. Isolated methods/{condition}/ working copies were reconstructed for actors and removed after execution to avoid keeping duplicate Markdown trees; historical tool paths refer to those copies.
review_correction: Initial review packet leaked method self-descriptions in limitations. Earlier review excluded; metadata removed and two fresh independent reviewers restarted. See blinding-correction.json.
